title: Recover Missing HTML
originalDescription: Open Bloom, select a book, close Bloom, delete the .htm file (NOT the bookhtml.bak file), and restart Bloom. Bloom should recover and display a warning to the user. Message says: "Bloom had a problem reading this book and recovered by restoring a recent backup. Please check recent changes to this book. If this happens for no obvious reason, please report it to us."

title: Comma Decimal Number Parsing
originalDescription: Change Windows "Regional format" to English (Swedish) such that the Decimal symbol is a comma rather than a period. Try stuff, including license dialog. Since number parsing bugs could happen anywhere, please do the remainder of your tests this day using this setting.  There is nothing specific to look for.  Number formatting depends on the assigned UI language (possibly the one when Bloom started), not the system locale setting.  [For Linux, maybe try starting Bloom like this:  "LANG=fr_FR.UTF-8 /usr/bin/bloom" to simulate having a European setup?]. Update Fix postponed to 5.8 board.

title: Book Thumbnail Status Badges
originalDescription: Badges: Book thumbnail badges indicating Bloom Library status. There are four statuses seen here. 1) uploaded & harvested 2) waiting for harvester 3) uploaded as draft 4) uploaded and removed from publication. Completion of harvesting -- movement from State (2) to (1) or (2) to 3) -- will only be shown after re-booting Bloom. Likewise, state (4) is only detected after initial re-boot (or changing collections). Test bulk upload.

title: Update Without Losing Branding
originalDescription: Update Books without losing branding: make a book with any current project branding and upload it then download it for editing. A new instance of Bloom opens. Verify branding is maintained in the book. Add a new page and re-upload the updated book (tick "yes"). Verify branding is retained on Blorg and new page has been added. Add another page. Go to settings Enterprise and change the branding to None. Upload to web again. This time the "yes" option should require you to tick a box to acknowledge the branding is changing to None. Tick both and upload. Verify branding for the book on Blorg. Change branding to None and reupload. Verify you have to acknowledge the change in branding. Upload and verify result on Blorg.

title: Change Book Ownership Permissions
originalDescription: Changing ownership: Log in as a Moderator and download a book for editing from the Pratham bookshelf which is not owned by either Moderator, Collection Editor, or Regular user. After Bloom opens, go to Publish to Web, tick agreements, and click upload. Under the "yes" option, the collision dialog should present tick box to change ownership. Don't upload. Close Bloom and log out as moderator and log in a Collection Editor. Open Bloom and Publish to Web again. The collision dialog should allow you to change ownership. Don't upload. Close Bloom and log out as Collection Editor and log in a Regular user. Open Bloom and Publish to Web again. The collision dialog should not present the option to change ownership and should not allow you to upload (i.e. after clicking "yes", the "upload" button should remain greyed out). Close Bloom and log out as Regular user and log in a Collection Editor. Open Bloom and Publish to Web again. The collision dialog should allow you to change ownership. Tick boxes and upload. Verify on Blorg that ownership has changed. Try re-uploading. This time the change-ownership box won't appear because owership has been transferred.

title: Branding Logos Across Formats
originalDescription:
Choose ONE particular branding and examine the following:

- Check logos appear correctly in the 1) Edit view 2) PDF 3) EPUB 4) Bloom Reader.  See the "Branding Screenshots" sheet in this file. [See settings/Bloom Enterprise. See the folder browser/branding/X for hints on what should appear for each branding. Images should appear where their names suggest. Json settings should be applied to new books.]  The brandings should be checked in generated books, not just in the Bloom preview. See notes at https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IRwsfHnvmR0AnhiJFgp8EOrFAhXmF1U3tOGe-Y7p2oA/edit?usp=sharing. Remember to set the appropriate xmatter, if the branding has a custom one associated with it. (JT 6.3: as far as I can find in the subscriptions doc, there is no longer a current Kyrgyz branding. This makes it difficult to test all the things in the notes. I tried the Little Zebra branding, which has obvious custom stuff on the bottom of the front cover, the bottom of the title page, and the top of the outside back cover. It does not, however, have hyperlinks.)

title: Harvester-Known Font Embeds
originalDescription: Create a book with a special/unique font which Harvester knows about.  The Harvester should succeed, and the book should be able to be read online with that font.  Downloaded ePUB and BloomPub books should contain the font so that they can be read with it.  If the font was used in a style, then the style in a downloaded book should still refer to the font even if hasn't been installed.  [Noto Sans Tamil from Google fonts is one that Harvester knows about.  Scheherazade New from SIL is another such font.]

caseSummary: Download one Look Listen Live books

6) Talking Book Language X is included in a BloomPUB if and only if:  language X is selected in the list of Talking Book Languages.

Upload the book to Bloom Library with SL feature checked and ensure SL icon appears. Upload the same book with SL feature unchecked and ensure video is uploaded but the book is not tagged for SL (SL icon does not appear). title: Missing Title And Copyright Warnings
originalDescription:
- Make a new book with no title and no text. Publish Tab Web. Verify both missing title and missing copyright appears. Click to fix copyright --> copyright warning is removed. Click to add title --> Edit opens at Front Cover. Publish Tab Web --> missing title warning remains. Click to fix --> Edit. Add a title. Publish Tab Web --> now the "Agreements" appear. Tick agreements. Sign In as a Regular user. 
If you are uploading to prod (not dev.blorg), make sure to mark DRAFT. Upload book. No collision dialog is presented.
description:

title: Moderator Reupload Keeps Uploader
originalDescription:
- Reupload by user with Moderator permission: In Bloom Edit, change the title once again. In Bloom Publish: Web, Sign Out, then back in with Moderator account. After clicking the Upload Book button, the collision shows you have permission. Ensure the uploader avatar matches the original uploader which is different from the avatar beside "you have permission". Under the "yes" option is a tick box to change the uploader. Do not tick that box. Choose "Yes" and then the UPLOAD button. Verify the uploaded book has the new title and has retained the original uploader.
Verify that Draft status is the same.

- Reupload by user with Moderator permission: In Bloom Edit, change the title once again. In Bloom Publish: Web, Sign Out, then back in with Moderator account. After clicking the Upload Book button, the collision shows you have permission. Ensure the uploader avatar matches the original uploader which is different from the avatar beside "you have permission". Under the "yes" option is a tick box to change the uploader. Do not tick that box. Choose "Yes" and then the UPLOAD button. Verify the uploaded book has the new title and has retained the original uploader.
Verify that Draft status is the same.
description:

title: Bulk Upload Quick Test
originalDescription:
Bulk Upload Quick Test
- Copy "Bulk Upload Quick Test" folder from Testing\Materials for Bloom Editor Testing\Bulk Upload Quick Test into Document/Bloom and open it
- update the Bloom Subscription to a newer valid one if necessary; make Bloom Library Bookshelf to be none; delete any of the books if they are still there from the last test pass
- Choose any book, Publish to Web, choose Upload this collection --> warning about needing to set the bookshelf
- set bookshelf and return to upload collection
- confirm results of 4 new books uploaded.
- On Blorg, confirm each according to the screenshots included in the front covers
- Without changing anything, republish collection: -> 4 books skipped
- Change one book, republish --> 1 book updated, 3 books skipped

originalDescription:
Download a Portrait accessible book like Aminata (https://bloomlibrary.org/book/oio92dZiu0) and a Landscape accessible book like Bo (https://bloomlibrary.org/chetana/book/1BMJGyHsm2?lang=en). Publish to ePUB and test results in preview and using eKiTabu for Windows.
Jan 2026 - I could not find any Android app which actually worked well. We used to specify using eKitabu for Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ekitabu.ereader&hl=en%5C) here. Even if you can find the old verison of the app which generally worked, talking books didn't work. Dolphin EasyReader played audio erratically. Lis-a talking books didn't work. Our latest research on readers is published at https://docs.bloomlibrary.org/ePUB-notes/.

title: Page Division Snap Points
originalDescription:
On a simple page with text and image, change the page division. 
- Snap points should occur at 33%, 50%, 66.7%, 75% as well a Match Previous Page and Fit Image. 
- Percentage should be whole numbers; try using CTRL and ensure %age is now in tenths of %age.
- Double-click to match previous page dimensions.
- Test on vertical divisions (portrait books) as well as horizontal divisions (landscape).

title: Resize Bubble Handles
originalDescription: Dragging side-edge controls resizes bubble: try all bubble types, all corners; try at multiple zoom levels. Most bubbles, including picture buttons, can be resized to any shape; but image and video overlays can only be sized in a way that preserves the aspect ratio of the picture. Again, things should snap to a grid unless ctrl is held down, and red alignment lines should show as appropriate; also green bars when the item being resized is the same height as something else. (Text bubbles are special and do not have corner handles.)

(JT 6.3: I think this is talking about the large button for choosing the main (background) image. title: Off-Page Bubble Tip Heals
originalDescription: Add a bubble with the tip that goes to a corner of the image box. Using "Change Layout", add more panels so that the tip is now off the page. When you toggle "Change Layout" off, the bubble should heal so that the tip is back on the image.
description: Add a bubble with the tip that goes to a corner of the image box. Using "Change Layout", add more panels so that the tip is now off the page. When you toggle "Change Layout" off, the bubble should heal so that the tip is back on the image.
caseSnapshot: Add a bubble with the tip that goes to a corner of the image box. Using "Change Layout", add more panels so that the tip is now off the page. When you toggle "Change Layout" off, the bubble should heal so that the tip is back on the image.
summary: Push a bubble's corner tip off-page via Change Layout; toggling it off should heal the tip back onto the image.
checklistSteps: Add a bubble with the tip that goes to a corner of the image box.
Using "Change Layout", add more panels so that the tip is now off the page.
When you toggle "Change Layout" off, the bubble should heal so that the tip is back on the image.
bodyChecklistItems: Add a bubble with the tip that goes to a corner of the image box.
Using "Change Layout", add more panels so that the tip is now off the page.

title: Character Style Language Inheritance
originalDescription: - Character changes made to L1 change the "normal" style, which then affects L2 & L3. But if you set a character style on L2 or L3, that choice will override "normal" for that language. This should be indicated by the message at the bottom of the character tab: "This formatting is for all LANGUAGE text boxes with "XXX" style". But see https://issues.bloomlibrary.org/youtrack/issue/BL-9965 before writing up inheritence issues.

title: Paste Paratext Scripture
originalDescription:
Copy/Paste scripture text from a Paratext project into a Bloom book to ensure that a) the text is not duplicated; b) superscripts for verse numbers are handled reasonably.
Bloom has code to find "\v N" and convert it to superscript, but this doesn't work when the incoming text is in html because of the markup. In my 6.1-6.3 testing w/PTX 9.5, pasting with Ctrl-V pasted as html and therefore did not give superscripts. Ctrl-Shift-V pasted as text and did.
If superscripts are added, those should be reversible using the standard ckeditor control.

Originally this said: superscripts for verse numbers are formatted as such when copying from "Unformatted" view; otherwise, from "Preview" & "Standard" you get unformatted numbers for verses, and "Formatted" gives backslash codes. Note, "HTML clipboard" prefix is ok.

title: Right-Click Rename Locks Folder
originalDescription: - Test the right-click rename function. This should rename the book's folder and .htm file, not the title of the book. Can also be started using F2. Subsequent renamings of the title should not affect the renamed folder -- it should be "locked". Right-click rename delete should restore the book back to match the title and unlock the book, i.e. renaming the title should not affect the book folder name. Ensure the position of the book thumbnail does not shift when renaming. Try renaming a book with a html5 widget (cf. BL-12598). If you make a BloomPub or other publications, the default filename should be based on the folder name, not the title. (JT 6.3: but if you made e.g. a BloomPub previously, Bloom remembers the name you used to make it, and that is the default rather than the current folder name. This is probably intentional, or at least OK, so I'm not making a bug report.)

Subsequent renamings of the title should not affect the renamed folder -- it should be "locked". Right-click rename delete should restore the book back to match the title and unlock the book, i.e. renaming the title should not affect the book folder name. Ensure the position of the book thumbnail does not shift when renaming. Try renaming a book with a html5 widget (cf. BL-12598). If you make a BloomPub or other publications, the default filename should be based on the folder name, not the title. (JT 6.3: but if you made e.g. a BloomPub previously, Bloom remembers the name you used to make it, and that is the default rather than the current folder name. This is probably intentional, or at least OK, so I'm not making a bug report.)

title: French Decodable Reader Stages
originalDescription:
- From installed French DR/LR source, make a derivative of "French DR". Mimimal Test procedure:
  1) Progressively move from page to page, observe and verify. For pages 1-13, each page should contain no highlighted words if the corresponding Stage is set, e.g. page 5 will show no highlighted words if stage is set to 5. Exceptions: Page 14 requires stage 11, & page 15 requires stage 12.
‌  2) Try adding 2 or 3 sight words to a stage which would not otherwise be acceptable for that stage, and ensure these words are not highlighted if added to a page.
  3) Remove diagraph "ch" from Letters, then on page 1 add the word "cha". Set stage to 1. "cha" should not be highlighted.

originalDescription: -  New books get whatever Decodable stage was last set with a control (not stage 1, not whatever stage was last "seen" in a book). A book made from a template in the bloompack gets whatever stage that book specifies.)

title: Quiz Cells Avoid Page Number

In Edit, add a new Quiz page
- Ensure the Quiz answer "cells" don't spill into the page number on a 16x9 Landscape or Portrait page, or a A5 page. Note: Decision in BL-9952 is we don't report overflow on Quiz pages. 
- Note also: we assume the user manages his/her text to not overflow (which is currently possible if you have multiple lines in the Question field). 
- A future improvement might allow scrolling,  We just haven't got around to it (JH).

Using above SL book, add image descriptions to images. Examine ePUB. Then check them in Simply Reading and another ePUB reader. Instead, click the hamburger menu in the app > device memory > select books > click upload arrow.] (JT 6.3: not sure what we're looking for here. Video doesn't show in epubs we make. I did add them, and they look about as expected in the one kind of preview that makes them. Also in Cool Reader. Simply Reading by Daisy is no longer on play store.)
Ekitabu may be as good as any: it plays videos and shows images.  It doesn't show image descriptions.
EasyReader shows images and image descriptions, but doesn't play videos.

title: Block Unlicensed Language Publish
originalDescription: When publishing (all formats: PDF (https://issues.bloomlibrary.org/youtrack/issue/BL-12332), BloomPUB (https://issues.bloomlibrary.org/youtrack/issue/BL-12333/5.5-regression-unauthorized-licensed-content-hole-part-2-BloomPUB), ePUB (https://issues.bloomlibrary.org/youtrack/issue/BL-12334), Web (https://issues.bloomlibrary.org/youtrack/issue/BL-12335), Video) a book with licensed content, stop publishing and show an error if one of the langs lacks a license in our spreadsheet. Test with a super bible book from here (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1W-eefTHmxhXsQuun5EhZsqtRNUCbWAWc). After closing the error message box, try to proceed with saving the book anyhow, over WiFi, over USB cable, etc. to ensure all publishing paths are truly closed.

Inline Formatting: Create a new page, enter some text. Select some words and give them color. Other words should have italics, etc. Everthing that we let you do with selected text. For some segment of text, apply all of that formatting to the same segment. Record the text.
Now export the book and import into a blank book.
--           Verify that the text has all the same formatting in Excel

title: Dutch Locale Install Error
originalDescription: [5.6] Error during installation when machine is in Dutch (JT 6.3: used https://xupefei.github.io/Locale-Emulator/, set app profile for installer exe to Dutch and told it to fake system UI language. Installer ran normally, but did not get the expected UI asking which localization to use. Tried using it on BloomBetaInternal.exe, but no context menu item: Locale Emulator does not handle 64-bit exes. Tried Locale Remulator, which does. Fiddled with LFConfig.xml to add Dutch, since its UI for configuration does not work. Tried running Bloom supposedly set to Dutch. No crash, but no UI asking me to choose locale. Tried built-in Run in Japanese. Same result. Don't think this is worth more effort, so checking off.)
